newsitem.title: ROMANIA: ROMANIAN LEU 3,311 TO DOLLAR FOR OCTOBER 22 - BNR.
newsitem.headline: ROMANIAN LEU 3,311 TO DOLLAR FOR OCTOBER 22 - BNR.

text.p: Romania's National Bank (BNR) announced the leu's reference rate lower at 3,311 to the dollar for October 22.
This reference rate was set on Friday as a weighted average based on daily reports of foreign exchange operators. It is a guidance rate used for statistical accounting purposes.
The leu's reference rate set on Thursday for October 21 is 3,306 to the dollar. It is 3,302 over the weekend. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
